findings.title: Refreshing a repaired workflow retains selected detail from the previous version
steps: Load complete matching scope and workflow version 4.
Attempt simulated close and return 409 changed-evidence/version refusal.
Advance the same workflow ID to version 5 in the simulated workflow list/detail and shared decision.
Click Refresh workflows; list and shared readiness become version 5 but selected detail remains version 4.
Observe Publish close package still disabled; reloading the same scope restores the matching detail.
findings.cause: refresh retains the selected workflow ID; the selected detail-fetch effect is keyed only by selectedWorkflowId and services, so it does not fetch new detail for an unchanged ID.
findings.repairDecision: pending; preserve the candidate and implementation order; fix and rerun in a later authorized focused candidate change
